sources.entry: CrossGen - Local-first AI image workspace for generating, editing, organizing, and reusing images through a desktop app, JSON CLI, and MCP-compatible agents.

summary.one_liner: CrossGen is a local-first AI image workspace: an Electron desktop app plus a JSON CLI and MCP stdio server for generating, editing, organizing, and reusing images with OpenAI, Gemini, and compatible providers.
summary.what_it_does: The desktop app lets you save API keys and Base URLs, run model discovery, and generate or edit images, with History and a Gallery that store results locally. Crop, annotate, add text, and pick colors in a preview/edit area, then save results to Gallery or drag them back in as image-to-image references. The same queue, provider settings, and Gallery are exposed through a packaged `crossgen` CLI with JSON output and an MCP stdio server (`--mcp`) for agents such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. MCP and CLI default to read-only; write and generate modes are opt-in, and paid generation requires confirmation. The README also describes GPT Image 2/2.5 and Gemini ("Nano Banana 3") model handling, including confirming exact provider model IDs before enabling a launch. Some of this (GPT Image 2.5 Sketch, the 0.3.5 release) is described as in development, and the download link still points at v0.3.4.
use_cases: generate image batches from prompts on a local desktop
edit or inpaint an existing image with a reference
let a coding agent generate UI or app assets via MCP
export selected generated images into a project folder
organize and tag reusable AI image assets
script image generation from a terminal with JSON output
how_to_run: Download the latest desktop release (macOS Apple Silicon .dmg, Windows x64 .exe, Linux x64 AppImage) from GitHub Releases
Open the app, go to API access, add an API key and Base URL, and run model discovery
crossgen generate --prompt "A precise isometric app icon" --model gpt-image-2.5-sunburst --quality xhigh --yes --wait --json
notable: Desktop app, JSON CLI, and MCP server share one durable generation queue, History, and Gallery
MCP access modes (readonly, write, generate) with paid generation and path disclosure gated by explicit confirmation
Model discovery confirms exact provider model IDs before enabling GPT Image 2/2.5 or Gemini launches
crossgen:// AppLink lets an API aggregator hand over a provider config after a confirmation dialog
Bundled crossgen-artist agent skill and Codex plugin
caveats: The v0.3.5 features described are in development; the README says the download link still points to v0.3.4 and a real-provider release gate is still pending
Desktop release packages are listed only for macOS Apple Silicon, Windows x64, and Linux x64; the README does not describe other platforms
Using GPT Image 2.5 and Gemini features depends on the API key's model discovery results; paid requests are involved and the README says real-provider gates need explicit cost approval
